title: estate.commerce.order_paid
description: Emitted by the commerce primitive once, after it has verified the payment-provider signature and written the money to its own ledger. The payload is the founder's, verbatim, from 2026-08-29. No consumer of this event ever talks to a payment provider: that is the whole point of the firewall.

user_id.description: estate identity subject, not a provider customer id

item_sku.description: plan code or wallet top-up code, e.g. 100_ai_credits

amount_paid.description: minor units, never a float: 2000 is $20.00
